\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{angles,quotes,decorations.text}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \coordinate (O) at (0,0);
  \coordinate (A) at (1,0);
  \coordinate (B) at (0,1);
  \draw[postaction={decorate,decoration={text along path,text align=center,text color=magenta,text={P}}}]
    (1.4,1.4) -- (O) pic[draw=red,fill=yellow,line width=4pt,angle radius=1cm,"Q"] {angle=A--O--B}
    (O) edge[draw=blue,line width=4pt] node[above left] {E} (1.4,1.4);
  \begin{scope}[xshift=2.2cm]
    \coordinate (O) at (0,0);
    \coordinate (A) at (1,0);
    \coordinate (B) at (0,1);
    \draw[postaction={decorate,decoration={text along path,text align=center,text color=magenta,text={P}}}]
      (1.4,1.4) -- (O) edge[draw=blue,line width=4pt] node[above left] {E} (1.4,1.4)
      (O) pic[draw=red,fill=yellow,line width=4pt,angle radius=1cm,"Q"] {angle=A--O--B};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
